One branch of econometrics deals with the analysis of time series data.

An excellent source of information is [Hyndman and Athanasopoulos (2018)](https://otexts.com/fpp2/).

A standard AR(1) model has the form

$$y_t = \alpha_1 y_{t - 1} + u_t,$$

where $y_t$ is the value of variable $y$ in period $t$, $\alpha_1$ is the coefficient describing the relationship between the current value of $y$ and its own lag, and $u_t$ is a normally distributed error term with zero mean and variance $\sigma^2$.

### References

Hyndman, R. J., & Athanasopoulos G. (2018). *Forecasting: Principles and Practice*. Heathmont: OTexts. <https://otexts.com/fpp2/>
